steps.do: Ask for the customer's business checking requirements one at a time: daily mobile deposit amount, overdraft fees, the most they can commit to keeping, minimum APY, monthly fee budget and waiver, ATM rebates, debit cashback, and anything else. Pin each figure down. Keep asking whether there is anything else until the customer has nothing left. Record every requirement as stated, and recommend nothing until they are done.
steps.quote: Always ensure the recommended account still meets ALL of the customer's stated requirements - do not recommend a promotional account if it does not satisfy the customer's needs.

steps.do:
Check every business checking product against every stated requirement, using the figures in this job's rules: Beige, Cobalt Blue, Hunter Green, Lime Green, Navy Blue, Sky Blue, True Blue, World Blue. Keep only the products that meet ALL of them.
- Minimum balance: drop a product whose required minimum (to stay in good standing or keep benefits) is above what the customer will commit to keep.
- Fee waiver: a waiver threshold is not a required minimum. Drop on a waiver threshold only when the customer wants the monthly fee waived or avoided.
- Debit cashback: if the customer wants cashback on general debit spending, keep only Cobalt Blue. Hunter Green's cashback applies only at certified eco vendors.
- Sky Blue: drop it if the customer will not accept the $25.00 fee that starts after its free period.
- Missing figures: a product whose documents give no figure for a stated requirement (for example no APY for World Blue or Beige) does not meet it.
- Equal figures: a figure equal to an 'at least' figure meets it.
- Products already held: do not drop a product the customer already holds unless it fails a requirement.

steps.do:
Choose the account to recommend from the qualifying set, using the date from v_time. If only one account qualifies, choose it. Otherwise work out each active notice's pick:
- November notice pick (active 11/01/2025-11/30/2025): Sky Blue if it qualifies, else Lime Green if it qualifies, else 'any qualifying account'.
- October notice pick (active 10/12/2025-11/12/2025): Lime Green if it qualifies, else Hunter Green if it qualifies, else 'any qualifying account'.
Then decide:
- One notice active: choose that notice's pick.
- Both active (11/01/2025-11/12/2025): if the two picks name the same account, choose it. If one pick is 'any qualifying account', choose the other notice's named pick, since both notices allow it. If they name different accounts (for example Sky Blue and Lime Green), the documents do not say which notice governs: tell the customer that both accounts meet every requirement and ask which they prefer.
- A pick of 'any qualifying account', or no notice active: no document ranks the accounts. Tell the customer how each qualifying account meets their requirements and ask which they prefer.

done_when: The customer is verified and the verification is logged. Every business checking requirement the customer stated has been collected. Then one of these is true: (a) one account that meets every requirement has been recommended (by the active notice's pick, or by the customer's choice where the documents do not settle one), the customer confirmed it, eligibility was confirmed from the records, and the account is open, before any requested closure; (b) the customer has been told why it could not be opened; or (c) the customer has been told that no account meets every requirement. If the customer also asked for business savings, opening_business_savings_accounts follows.
